instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. On a sunny autumn path in a wooded park, the woman in the black puffer jacket and mint beanie (R1) walks forward in the center foreground, looking ahead. Walking closely behind her left side is the toddler girl in the pink turban beanie and skull-print jumpsuit (R2), looking forward. Warm sunlight filters through the trees, casting long shadows on the paved path scattered with fallen leaves, creating a bright, natural atmosphere.
